test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

Some students are known to grow wise early.

options.text: Some students have been knowing that they grow wise early.
People know that some students grow wise early.
Few of us know that students grow early
We all know that students grew wise early.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Active voice structure: The subject performs the action in the sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the object of the sentence becomes the subject. In this case, "some students" is the subject of the active sentence.
 
• To convert to active voice: The subject of the sentence should be the doer of the action, and the sentence should be directly stating the action.
 
• In Option 2, "People know that some students grow wise early" transforms the passive structure to active voice appropriately.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"People know that some students grow wise early."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Some students have been knowing that they grow wise early" – Incorrect as the verb "knowing" is used wrongly in the continuous form here.
 
• **Option 3:** "Few of us know that students grow early" – Incorrect because "grow early" lacks proper context (it should be "grow wise early").
 
• **Option 4:** "We all know that students grew wise early" – Incorrect as it uses the past tense "grew" instead of the present tense "grow" to indicate a general truth.
